tools.name: gridlabs_get_tariff_scenario
tools.description: Read one documented electricity cost scenario from the same verified source reader as the website. Limited panel, annualized EUR TTC costs, sources and review dates. Not a quote, market-wide ranking or subscription eligibility. No custom profile or bulk export.

tools.name: gridlabs_get_commune_electricity_consumption
tools.description: Latest publishable residential electricity consumption for one French commune. Annual kWh per delivery point, source and year. No professional data, no geographic fallback, no household estimate. Unavailable is not zero.

tools.name: gridlabs_get_commune_gas_consumption
tools.description: Latest publishable residential gas consumption for one French commune. Annual kWh per delivery point, not household consumption or address eligibility. Returns source and year; unavailable is not zero.

tools.name: gridlabs_get_agent_discovery
tools.description: Returns the API catalog (RFC 9727), OpenAPI JSON, and llms.txt for the site. Also see /.well-known/ai-catalog.json for ARD discovery.

tools.name: gridlabs_get_subscribe_intent
tools.description: Returns next_url and funnel metadata for the comparison questionnaire (public, no login).
